result.justification: The study has a clear objective and a well-defined methodology, with explicit details on participant recruitment, session structure, and data analysis.

evidence.quote: This qualitative study aims to describe the lived experience of women participating in the 'Maternity and Cultures' discussion group.
We used Interpretative Phenomenological Analysis (Smith, 2003) complemented by discourse and content analysis.
The sessions took place over two years, following the discussion group model established in the unit in 2015.
